name: Andy Turner
source: Andy is the husband of Jennifer and Maya's father. Him and Jennifer were high school sweethearts and ended up getting married when Jennifer got pregnant in their college junior year. As a university research assistant, he sometimes has to travel to attend conferences and for his studies, which just happens to be the case at the start of this story.
